### Self-review

- Read the diff top to bottom. The only wire is `EgressTransport` —
  the mediator resolves fresh, re-checks non-public/deny on the
  *answer* (SSRF pivot closed), substitutes sentinels whose own
  binding covers the destination, pre-gates `network.calls`, then
  delivers. No path skips `decide_egress`.
- `security.egress.requested` commits before decision and `decided`
  before the outcome is visible — a crash anywhere leaves the true
  durable prefix (denials never resolve credentials).
- The approval cache can never widen: lookup is narrowing-only,
  version-pinned, opt-in via `amendment.session_cache`; `once`
  endorses are never cached.
- `sentinel_refs` on `requested` records placeholder *spellings*
  (refs) — no value material touches any durable surface; the LT-04
  leak scan over committed payloads is empty including rotated-out
  values.
- `RevokeIntent` deliberately rides mediated egress — revocation is
  egress and gets the same decide/charge/durable discipline (no
  privileged side channel).
- No debug output, no secret material in the diff; masks/`provided`
  only (SV-1…SV-10 preserved — `sv*.rs` unchanged-green).
